summary.intent: Debug and fix a bug where the FUSE-mounted folder showed stale file content after editing a file via the web UI, then add cross-client sync E2E tests to prevent regressions.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified and fixed in inode.rs (populate_folder never re-resolved already-resolved files); web UI fixed to republish folder metadata with updated modified_at on file save; cross-client sync E2E test scripts added; all changes committed to fix/fuse-stale-file-after-web-edit branch.

repo: FUSE inode resolution uses a TTL-based refresh cycle (~30s) via drain_refresh_completions calling populate_folder; already-resolved files (file_meta_resolved: true) were never re-checked even when folder metadata showed a newer modified_at on the FilePointer.

The web UI's file save flow (useFileOperations.ts) only published the per-file IPNS record and did NOT republish folder metadata with an updated modified_at, meaning the FUSE polling loop never detected the change — both the inode.rs fix and the web UI fix were required together.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish was already imported in useFileOperations.ts but only called during IPNS key migration, not on normal file edits.

The @cipherbox/api-client package has a generated dist that can become stale; the PublishIpnsDto publicKey type error was caused by a stale build, not missing source — fixed by running the api:generate script.

Desktop E2E round-trip tests use the SDK pointed at the local dev instance; the SDK has uploadFile, updateFileMetadata, replaceFileInFolder, and updateFolderMetadataAndPublish for scripting full vault operations.

The root folder IPNS keypair is derived deterministically from the user's private key via deriveVaultIpnsKeypair(userKeypair.privateKey); file IPNS private keys are unwrapped per-file from the FilePointer's encrypted key material.

code.finding: populate_folder() previously preserved existing InodeKind wholesale for file_meta_resolved: true inodes. Fix compares incoming FilePointer.modified_at with existing inode mtime; if newer, marks file unresolved so drain_refresh_completions picks it up. Also detects replaced FilePointer (different ipns_name) and clears stale key material in that case.

test_populate_folder_resets_resolved_file_on_modified_at_change covers: (a) unchanged modified_at keeps resolved state, (b) newer modified_at resets to unresolved with IPNS name preserved, (c) replaced FilePointer (same name, different ipns_name, same modified_at triggers identity-change path) clears old key material and updates to new pointer.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish was only called during IPNS key migration. Added call after every successful file save so folder metadata modified_at is always updated and propagated to FUSE clients via their polling cycle.

New script for editing a file via SDK: auth → load vault key blob → load folder metadata → resolve file IPNS → decrypt file key → encrypt new content → upload to IPFS → update file metadata IPNS record → republish folder metadata with new modified_at.
New E2E test: writes file via FUSE mount, waits for SDK visibility, edits via SDK (simulating web UI), waits one IPNS polling cycle (~60s), reads from mount and asserts updated content.

workflow: The gsd-debugger subagent pattern effectively isolates investigation context (88 tool uses, ~1.18M tokens) from the orchestrator's lean conversation context.
Cargo.lock gets phantom diffs when cargo check runs inside a worktree/session even without Cargo.toml changes; always revert with git checkout Cargo.lock before committing.
When a typecheck error appears on a generated client package, check if the dist is stale before investigating the source — api:generate may be needed.
CodeRabbit and Copilot review threads can be bulk-replied and resolved via gh api graphql resolveReviewThread mutation after implementing fixes.

friction: Commit failed due to 1Password SSH agent not being unlocked, leaving staged changes uncommitted mid-session.
Multiple internal server errors (500) from the API interrupted the session, requiring the user to retry messages.
Cargo.lock phantom diffs appeared twice (after cargo check runs) requiring manual revert each time.
git stash + branch switch required to consolidate changes from a detached working state onto the fix branch.
The web UI's folder metadata republish gap meant the inode.rs fix alone was insufficient — a second fix in a different layer was needed to make the feature actually work end-to-end.
git checkout main (for pre-existing typecheck error verification) stashed and needed manual restoration of working changes.
open_items: The cross-client sync E2E test requires a running desktop app with FUSE mount and local dev instance — not yet wired into CI; needs infrastructure work to run automatically.
The edit-filepointer.mjs script needs to be tested against an actual local dev instance to verify the SDK call sequence works end-to-end.
The ~30-60s IPNS poll wait in the E2E test makes it slow for CI; consider whether the TTL can be reduced in test mode or if a signal-based approach is feasible.

The replaced-FilePointer case in populate_folder (different ipns_name, same modified_at) is handled by the code fix but this scenario may be practically impossible in production — worth documenting the assumption.
Pre-existing TypeScript error in ipns.service.ts on main branch (unrelated to this fix) should be tracked and resolved separately.
